== Biography ==
Caroline Eleanor Glasgow was born on 23 March 1865 and baptised on 3 June 1865 at Umritsur, Bengal, India. The index names Francis Charles Macpherson Glasgow and Mary Caroline as her parents.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/1137351 Ancestry, India, Select Births and Baptisms, 1786–1947: Caroline Eleanor Glasgow, record 9899/1137351].</ref><ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/218941 Ancestry, India, Select Births and Baptisms, 1786–1947: Caroline Eleanor Glasgow, record 9899/218941].</ref>

[[Category:Glasgow Name Study]]
== Biography ==
Noel Robertson-Glasgow was born 25 December 1881 and baptised 19 January 1882 at Kasauli, Bengal, India. The index names his father as John Campbell Robertson-Glasgow and his mother as Geraldine.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9899/records/91571 Ancestry, India, Select Births and Baptisms, 1786–1947: Noel Robertson-Glasgow, 25 December 1881, baptised 19 January 1882, Kasauli]</ref>

The 1909 marriage index records Noel Robertson Glasgow, age 27, marrying Effie Lorne Campbell on 22 July 1909 at Dunga Gali, Bengal, and names the same father. It gives birth year 1882; the baptism index's exact 25 December 1881 date is retained as the stronger date evidence.<ref>[https://www.ancestry.co.uk/search/collections/9901/records/444956 Ancestry, India, Select Marriages, 1792–1948: Noel Robertson Glasgow and Effie Lorne Campbell, 22 July 1909]</ref>
